eyebrow: AI for Founders Mastery · November 2026 cohort
title: Getting to know you
intro: This takes about four minutes. Your answers shape the programme: the businesses we build with live, the help you get before week 1, and what each teacher focuses on.

thanks.title: Thank you. You're all set.

steps.what: Get AI-Ready drop-in: setup, your first pack and your hours log
Get AI-Ready drop-in: the go-live clinic
Week 1 goes live at 7am Los Angeles / 3pm London

thanks.note: Your answers go to Vishen, Vykintas and each teacher before their week.

sections.title: About you
sections.sub: The basics, so we know who is in the room.

qs.q: Your name
qs.why: Pre-filled from the welcome email link where possible.

qs.q: Email address
qs.why: Joins this survey to your enrolment and your summit answers.

qs.q: Phone number
qs.why: Only for your concierge, if email doesn't reach you.

qs.q: Gender
Age
Where are you based?
qs.why: Sets the time zones for drop-ins and lab rooms. The live form uses the full country list.

qs.q: Your personal annual income
qs.why: Standard on every Mastery survey, so cohorts can be compared.

qs.q: Have you joined a Mindvalley Mastery or Certification before?
qs.why: AI Mastery alumni need less setup help. Expert & Authority students have covered offers, copy and funnels before, so those teachers can go further.

sections.title: Your business
sections.sub: So the live builds use businesses like yours.

qs.q: Which of these sounds most like you today?
opts: I have a job and I'm exploring a business
I'm planning a business, not started yet
I'm a solo founder, it's mostly me
I run a small team (2–10 people)
I run a bigger team (11+ people)
qs.why: Puts you in the solo or the team room in the Thursday labs. Same wording as the summit survey, so we can compare buyers with registrants.

qs.q: In the last 12 months, roughly what did your business earn?
qs.why: Same wording as the summit survey. Lets teachers pitch their examples at the right scale.

qs.q: In one sentence: what do you sell, and to whom?
qs.ph: For example: leadership coaching for first-time managers in tech
qs.why: Vykintas picks real businesses from these to build with live in weeks 1 and 2.

sections.title: Where you're starting
sections.sub: So you're set up before week 1.

qs.q: Where are you with AI in your business today?
opts: I use it for writing and ideas
I use it regularly for specific tasks
It's built into how my business runs
qs.why: Same wording as the summit survey. Sets how much hand-holding the early labs need.

qs.q: Have you used Claude Code before?
qs.why: Everything we build runs on it. Anyone who isn't using it yet gets a personal nudge to the Get AI-Ready drop-ins on 5 and 12 November.

qs.q: Which computer will you use for the programme?
qs.why: The builds need a Mac or Windows computer. Anyone else hears from a concierge before week 1.

qs.q: Which of these does your business already have?
opts: An email tool (Kit, Mailchimp or similar)
A free download or lead magnet
qs.why: Tells each teacher what the room starts from: website (week 1), email (weeks 7 and 8), Meta (week 12), books (week 13), CRM (week 14), team (week 17). Website addresses let Vykintas look before week 1, and a saved snapshot gives every student a before and after at graduation.

sections.title: Your goals
sections.sub: What you want this programme to change.

qs.q: Which part of your business would you most like off your plate first?
opts: Product and what to build next
qs.why: Same wording as the summit survey. Vishen's opening speaks to the top answers.

qs.q: What has stopped you automating more so far?
opts: I don't know where to start
I've tried tools but didn't get real results
I don't have the time to set it up
I'm worried about data and safety
My team isn't on board yet
I'm not sure it's worth the cost
qs.why: Same wording as the summit survey. If many pick data and safety, the week 5 privacy segment runs longer.

qs.q: Which of these would you most love to have running by 30 March?
opts: A website and offer that sell for me
A company brain all my AI tools read from
My inbox and admin handled every morning
A brand and funnel that collect leads while I sleep
Being found on ChatGPT and Google, with content every week
Meta ads running without an agency
Every lead followed up, and more of them closed
One screen to run the business, and a week where I only decide
qs.why: One option per part of the programme, in curriculum order. Shows which modules matter most to the room, and which outcomes to lead with for the next cohort.

qs.q: If AI gave you back one day a week, what would you do with it?
qs.why: The reason behind the hours. Vishen can open the programme with the room's answers, and graduation stories start here.

qs.q: By graduation on 30 March, what would you like to have built, and what would it change for you?
qs.why: Read back to you at graduation, next to what you actually built.

sections.title: Your starting point
sections.sub: Four quick measures. We ask them again at graduation so you can see how far you've come.

qs.q: Which of these do you feel least confident about?
opts: Building a website and offer that sell
Organising what AI knows about my business
Handing email and admin to AI
Building a brand and a funnel
Getting found online and making content
Handing work to my team or to AI
qs.why: Same order as the goals list above. Each teacher gets both counts for their week: how many want it, and how many fear it.

qs.q: In a normal week, how many hours do you work on your business?
qs.why: The programme's main measure. The hours log in week 0 makes it precise.

qs.q: How confident are you that you could get AI to do real work in your business, not just answer questions?
qs.why: The headline before-and-after number at graduation.

qs.q: How comfortable are you giving AI access to your business email and files?
qs.why: Week 5 is the first time AI reads your inbox. A low room average means more time on privacy.

qs.q: Did you attend the AI for Founders Summit (30 October to 1 November)?
qs.why: Tells Vishen and Vykintas what the room has already seen, so week 1 builds on it instead of repeating it.

qs.q: Lessons are live on Tuesdays and labs on Thursdays, 7am Los Angeles / 3pm London. Which can you join?
qs.why: Labs work best live. If many can't make Thursdays, we add a second lab time.

qs.q: Would you be happy to share your results as a student story?
qs.why: For Demo Day and case studies. We always ask again before using anything.

qs.q: Anything else you'd like Vishen and the team to know?
qs.why: Ileana reads every answer before week 1 and follows up on anything that needs a reply.
